_meta.generation_prompt:
You are helping build text conditions for a class-conditional image diffusion
model and for CLIP text embeddings.

For the visual object category "{classname}", write exactly {k} short English
descriptions. Requirements:
  * Each description must start with "a photo of a {classname}" or
    "a photo of the {classname}" and then add concrete VISUAL attributes.
  * Mention colour, shape, texture, material, typical parts and typical
    surroundings - the things that make the category visually recognisable.
  * Vary the descriptions: different viewpoints, contexts, colours, instances.
  * One line each, no numbering, no extra commentary, max 25 words per line.
Return only the {k} lines.
